role: Style transfer to nine new subjects; no placeholder input
atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Replace the NINE SUBJECTS of the attached style-reference atlas with nine NEW inventory glyphs listed below. The reference is for WHITE-GLYPH STYLE, simplicity and square 3x3 format ONLY: do not reproduce its existing runner, book, fuel can, crossed axes or old subject compositions.
ONE square 3x3 atlas, nine equal cells in strict ROW-MAJOR ORDER, no grid lines, no cell labels. Pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF shapes on perfectly clean pure BLACK #000000 background. Serious post-apocalyptic dnd5e UI stencil language; broad practical silhouettes, broad black negative-space cuts, very restrained interior detail. Readability at 16/24/32 px is essential. NO shading, greys, gradients, dithering, speckles, texture, hatching, fine scratches, thin facial wrinkles, delicate hair strands, anime expressions/hair, exaggerated cartoon proportions, readable text, initials, numerals, logos, watermark or borders. No gore. Do not use giant generic cogs, playful arrows or floating toy fragments.
Every complete subject must fit in the middle 60% of its own cell with at least 20% blank margin on ALL FOUR sides. Whole heads, hands, limbs, tool handles and gun barrels stay visible. No marks crossing cell boundaries. Hands have coherent fingers and wrists; all people are generic adults, no celebrities or recognizable characters.
ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
1. a-co-mi-tam: A calm rugged adult survivor from the chest up, shrugging off a dangerous drink: one complete hand holds a small plain bottle near the shoulder, with one broad radiation trefoil behind the opposite shoulder. Untroubled expression, solid short hair and one simple mouth cut. Innate resistance to poison, disease and radiation; no gas mask or protective suit, no lettering.
2. amen: Two complete realistic adult hands pressed together in prayer above ONE simple six-sided die with three large pips. Broad plain sleeves, clear black gaps between folded thumbs and palms. A compact prayer-and-second-chance motif; no written words, cross, halo, recognizable religious figure, extra hands or tiny fingernails.
3. berserk: One powerful rugged adult survivor from bare chest upward, roaring with two clenched fists raised near the shoulders. Thick neck and broad chest, solid cropped hair, a single stern brow cut and simple open mouth. Two short broad angular adrenaline strokes outside the shoulders. Coherent realistic fists and arms; no anime hair, fine facial hatching, fangs, extra limbs or gore.
4. bez-tajemnic: One large practical magnifying glass examining a simple mutant's head in profile: one broad ear, one short blunt horn and a solid neck silhouette. In the lens, one simple crosshair cut marks a vulnerable point on the head. The lens and head overlap clearly with broad black gaps, not multiple heads; no gore, tiny teeth, laboratory labels or decorative symbols.
5. bezlitosny-przywodca: One stern adult gang leader shown from the chest up, one complete arm extended to point decisively toward the right. Two smaller subordinate shoulder-and-head silhouettes sit behind the leader, one on either side. Clear separation between all three people, serious practical clothing, no fine face detail, badge, lettering, crown or extra hands.
6. brutalny-cios: One heavy clenched fist entering from the upper left strikes the shoulder of a simple full human silhouette, which tilts backward and loses its footing toward the lower right. A single broad angular impact wedge at the shoulder conveys a powerful knockdown. Both legs and the head remain complete; no blood, wound detail, crushed face, extra fist or extra person.
7. bystrzacha: One robust practical folding multitool, opened with its pliers at the top and one broad screwdriver blade and one short utility knife folded out to the sides. A coherent single tool with intact handles and one visible hinge; broad functional silhouettes and generous black gaps. Versatile hands-on competence, no giant cog, brain, decorative stars, scattered toy parts, lettering or tiny serrations.
8. cichy-krok: One complete sturdy boot in three-quarter side view, making a careful quiet toe-step across two low flat rocks, heel raised. Two short broad air trails behind the heel suggest light silent movement. Broad boot shape with only a few practical seam cutouts; no tiny laces, texture, footprint trail, extra boot, labels or cartoon sound effect.
9. clint: One realistic adult gloved hand holding a classic six-shot revolver in clear side profile, barrel aimed toward the upper right. Large coherent cylinder and simple trigger guard, intact grip, thumb and fingers. Two short broad recoil or quick-draw strokes behind the hand. A generic skilled gunslinger motif, no celebrity portrait, recognizable character, extra gun, extra barrel, lettering or fine engraving.
Final checks: cell 1 is an untroubled survivor resisting hazardous drink/radiation, never a protective suit. Cell 2 prayer hands plus ONE die, no religious lettering. Cell 3 a rugged raging adult with TWO intact fists, no anime. Cell 4 a single mutant head examined with ONE magnifying lens. Cell 5 leader and two subordinates, exactly three people. Cell 6 ONE fist knocks ONE whole figure backward, no injuries. Cell 7 ONE coherent multitool, not disconnected parts. Cell 8 ONE complete boot stepping quietly across low rocks. Cell 9 ONE hand and ONE revolver, generic gunslinger without an actor's face. All shapes WHITE ONLY and background BLACK ONLY.
